alate: The head is brown tinged with black, the labrum and postclypeus greyish brown, the anteclypeus white; the antennae pale blackish brown with white between the segments, the compound eyes blackish brown, the ocelli pale yellow, the antennal spots brown; the pronotum and the femoral and tibial segments of the legs all greyish yellow, the wings pale blackish brown. The head capsule is round with squarish tendencies, the fontanelle dot-like, about 0.48 mm from the anterior frontal margin. The compound eyes are roundly triangular, the projection rate 2–5 per cent, the short diameter greater than the distance from the compound eye to the lower margin of the head. The ocelli are oval, the ocellus-compound eye distance roughly comparable to the short diameter of the ocellus. Antennae with 16 segments. The postclypeus projects, almost level with the vertex and higher than the ocelli. The anterior margin of the pronotum is slightly upturned, composed of two broad arcs, with a shallow U-shaped median notch, the middle of the posterior margin with a shallow incision, its width about 1.46–1.52 times its length. The forewing 6.73–6.88 mm long and 1.6–1.72 mm wide; the hindwing 6.27–6.58 mm long and 1.6–1.72 mm wide; the branches of the Cu vein about ten each.
soldier: Head pale yellowish brown, mandibles reddish brown, the pilosity of the head capsule moderate. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index 0.56–0.63, the sides nearly parallel and slightly constricted behind the antennal sockets; the frontal ridge is raised, nearly flat between the ridges. The labrum is lingulate, the apex bluntly rounded, the apical and subapical hairs both present, the lateral-apical hairs reduced. The apices of the mandibles are rather curved, the mandibular condyle visible, its length 0.5–0.57 times the head capsule length and 0.87–0.95 times the head width. Antennae with 14–15 segments. The broadest region of the postmentum lies at the anterior one-fifth, the anterolateral margins trapezoidal, the middle slightly concave; the waist region narrow and long with the sides parallel, the waist constriction index 0.31–0.39. The pronotum is about 1.45–1.58 times as wide as long, the anterior margin with a broad V-shaped shallow notch, the middle of the posterior margin slightly concave, with about thirty hairs in the middle region.
taxonomy_note: The genus name is printed in the original work as Reticuliter mes, a misspelling of Reticulitermes; it is now assigned to the genus Reticulitermes.
